description: Deep alert investigation view with event metadata, model scores, sequence evidence, anomaly attribution, session lifecycle, next event prediction, and user business context.

elements.label: Explain with AI Button
elements.description: Button that opens the AI explanation modal for the current alert.
exampleUserQuestions: highlight where should i click to explain an alert with AI
show me the explain with AI button
where is the AI explain button

elements.label: Evidence Payload Button
elements.description: Button within the AI explanation modal that shows the raw evidence payload JSON.
exampleUserQuestions: show evidence payload for this alert

elements.label: Advanced Context Button
elements.description: Button that expands the advanced context section within the alert investigation view.
exampleUserQuestions: where is the more context button

elements.label: Back to Alerts Button
elements.description: Button that navigates back to the Alerts list page.

elements.label: Refresh Investigation
elements.description: Button that refreshes the investigation data for the current alert.

elements.label: Alert Header Section
elements.description: Header showing the risk level badge, event ID, anomaly type, timestamp, and final risk score with progress bar.

elements.label: Event Metadata
elements.description: Card showing event metadata fields such as event action, API template, API family, country, device, browser, OS, HTTP method, and status.

elements.label: Model Scores
elements.description: Card showing anomaly detection model scores including XGBoost, LightGBM, Transformer, TCN, and rule-based scores.

elements.label: Model Contributions
elements.description: Card showing the contribution breakdown of each model to the final risk score.

elements.label: Sequence Evidence
elements.description: Card showing sequence-based evidence, selected model, scores, top surprise fields, and context metrics.

elements.label: Tabular Evidence
elements.description: Card showing tabular evidence including available models, unavailable models, and feature warnings.

elements.label: Rule Evidence
elements.description: Card showing triggered rules, rule contributions, and rule evidence details.

elements.label: Anomaly Attribution
elements.description: Card showing anomaly type attribution source, confidence, and triggered anomaly type.

elements.label: Session Lifecycle
elements.description: Card showing the session lifecycle events, end reason, duration, event count, and finalization status.

elements.label: Next Event Prediction
elements.description: Card showing next event prediction results, deviation evidence, expected vs actual actions, predicted probabilities, and top-K matches.

elements.label: User Business Context
elements.description: Card showing user business context including churn risk, forecast context, and persona information.

elements.label: Data Source Chip
elements.description: Chip showing the data source for the investigation data.
exampleUserQuestions: what is the investigation data source
